provenance.integer_authority: Locked prior independent drafts and exact signed bytes; never RPC floating amounts.
provenance.incoming_time: Receiver first-seen time is not supplied by the old source. Incoming recorded_at_ms=0 is explicitly modeled; only outgoing time uses the old sender timereceived.
provenance.synthetic_scope: All transport IDs, capture clocks, modeled rows and lifecycle facts are wire controls, not authentication, current wallet observations or finality.
provenance.identity_scope: Only the two frozen public fixture root/gym tuples and inherited exact pin/trust are modeled; no general new key/address oracle.
provenance.crypto_scope: Raw SHA256 is independently computed over locked prior bytes. No new transaction parsing/signing/storage expected output is consumed.
